info.title: Respondi API
info.description: Auth and account API for Respondi. Paths are relative to the /api base. The account id is the Cognito access token subject.

servers.description: Deployed API Gateway stage. Replace apiId with the ApiUrl output for the environment.

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Business profile, addresses, catalog, and FAQs

CognitoAuth.description: Cognito access token. The account id is the token subject and is never accepted in the path, query, or body.

ProductLimit.name: limit
ProductLimit.description: Page size. Defaults to 20. Maximum is 50.

BadRequest.description: The request body or query is invalid.

Unauthorized.description: The access token is missing or invalid.

NotFound.description: The account profile or record was not found.

Conflict.description: The write conflicts with an existing phone number, FAQ limit, or concurrent update.

start.description: Local time, HH:mm. Must be before end on the same day.

productId.description: Optional service id for this window. Null or omitted means the window applies to all services.

accountId.description: Cognito subject of the signed-in user.

email.description: Copied from Cognito. Writes that send email are rejected.

phone.description: E.164 business number used to match incoming WhatsApp messages.

contactPhone.description: Optional contact number in E.164. This number is not used to match WhatsApp messages.

hours.description: Business-wide hours. Always empty when scheduleMode is per_address.

ProfileWrite.description: Email and account id are not accepted. When scheduleMode is business, hours is required. When it is per_address, hours must be omitted or empty.

ProfilePatch.description: At least one field is required. Switching scheduleMode to business requires hours.

hours.description: Used only when the profile scheduleMode is per_address. Empty when hours belong on the business.

PricePlan.description: Named price option for a service (for example Mensual or 8 clases).

priceMinor.description: Price in minor currency units. 1500 with currency USD is 15.00.

rules.description: Optional AI guidance for this plan price (discounts, conditions, extras).

kind.description: Catalog item kind. Services can be linked to schedule windows.

priceMinor.description: For products: unit price. For services: usually the lowest plan price (from price). 1500 with currency USD is 15.00.

priceRules.description: Optional AI guidance for a product unit price (discounts, conditions).

pricingRules.description: Optional service-wide AI guidance that applies across plans (for example annual inscription fee).

plans.description: Named plans for services. Empty for products.

nextCursor.description: Pass this value as the cursor query parameter to read the next page. Null on the last page.

sortOrder.description: Defaults to the current FAQ count so new FAQs append to the list.

AuthTokens.description: Cognito token field names are returned as issued.

acceptedTerms.description: Must be true. User explicitly accepted the Terms & Conditions.

acceptedTermsVersion.description: Version identifier of the T&C the user accepted.

marketing.description: User opted in to receive commercial communications. Defaults to false.

post.summary: Sign in with a Google ID token
post.description: Verifies the Google token, finds or creates the Cognito user, and returns Cognito tokens. An email that already belongs to a password account is rejected and is not linked.
